create_clearml_platform: create a ClearmlPlatform instance to log training metrics to ClearML
create_tensorboard_platform: create a TensorboardPlatform instance to log training metrics to TensorBoard
report_scalar_clearml: report a scalar value to ClearML using the ClearmlPlatform report_scalar method
report_scalar_tensorboard: report a scalar value to TensorBoard using the TensorboardPlatform report_scalar method
close_platform: close a TrainPlatform instance to clean up logging resources
